$purpose: Pinned canonical queries for the Full JEL Article eval harness. Each query gets one search_run_id pinned so retrieval is held constant during model A/Bs and skill-quality gates. Mirrors evals/queries.json conventions where they overlap.
$pinning_instructions: Run scripts/jel-survey/pin-eval-search-runs.ts to (re)pin search_run_ids. Default skips queries already pinned; pass --force to repin. Inserts via admin client and bypasses the HTTP auth gate.

queries.query: What is the impact of conditional cash transfers on school enrollment and learning outcomes?
queries.intent: CCT/UCT programs (PROGRESA/Oportunidades, Bolsa Familia, Familias en Accion, Juntos) effects on enrollment, attendance, attainment, learning. RCT-heavy. LAC-origin literature. DIR: program -> education outcome with causal design. INDIRECT: theoretical/structural models without CCT data; cash transfers with non-education outcomes that mention education in passing; descriptive evaluations without comparison group. IRRELEVANT: cash assistance outside the LAC CCT family or with no link to schooling.
queries.notes: Canonical development-economics survey topic. Should yield 200+ candidates after retrieval. Use to validate: outline generation, anchor+replication+contrary discipline, LAC register from style calibration. List et al. 2023 JEL is the strongest register match (real JEL, experiments-with-children frame, methodological); Banerjee-Duflo on-domain; Globalization-LAC carries the LAC register.

queries.query: How does artificial intelligence and automation affect employment, wages, and the task content of work?
queries.intent: AI / automation / robotics effects on labor markets. DIR: technology adoption shock -> employment, wage, or task-content changes with causal design. INDIRECT: macro productivity papers without an explicit labor channel; pure forecasting without causal identification; papers on technology adoption without labor outcomes. IRRELEVANT: pure CS/ML papers; AI in non-labor settings (e.g., healthcare diagnosis accuracy).
queries.citationProfile: NBER/SSRN-HEAVY (Acemoglu, Autor, Restrepo). EXERCISES THE Gemini ss: PREFIX HALLUCINATION BUG.
queries.notes: Bug-magnet query. Validate: claim-auditor, reference dedup/normalization (specifically the ss: bug fix), section drafting under non-DOI citation pressure. Acemoglu-Restrepo is topical anchor; Korinek 2023 JEL on Generative AI is recent register match for the Gen-AI subtopic; Chetty provides empirical-methodology voice.

queries.query: What policies effectively reduce labor market informality in Latin America?
queries.intent: Policies targeting informality reduction: simplified tax regimes (Monotributo, Simples Nacional), enforcement intensity, formalization incentives, social insurance portability, contributory pension design. LAC focus. DIR: policy lever -> informality measure with causal design. INDIRECT: descriptive informality measurement papers without policy intervention; cross-country macro papers without LAC focus. IRRELEVANT: informality outside labor (housing, finance) unless an explicit labor channel is identified.
queries.citationProfile: Mixed DOI + LAC institutional (IDB working papers, CEPAL, World Bank LAC reports)
queries.notes: LAC-specific structural topic. Validate: prior-survey positioning (Levy 'Good Intentions, Bad Outcomes' 2008; Perry et al. 'Informality: Exit and Exclusion' WB 2007), LAC register, mixed-evidence handling when RCTs are rare. Globalization-and-Inequality carries LAC institutional voice; Shy 2023 JEL on Cash use is topically adjacent (cash is the medium of informal economy) and provides real JEL register; Duflo for experimental methodology voice.
